title: Procedure execution investigation
scope: Agent procedure and enforcement machinery in C:/x; no production changes

findings.claim: Project Claude settings declares a Write|Edit pre-tool command with --auto-ground and a Stop command. This is a configuration declaration, not observed invocation.
limits: Current Claude documentation uses nested hooks handlers. Local flat command entries were not validated by launching Claude.
No PostToolUse command is declared here.

findings.claim: Direct subprocess invocation rejects a 60-line file truncation with the recognized input envelope, but silently allows the same proposed truncation under a tool_input envelope.
limits: These runs prove copied script behavior, not automatic interception by Codex or Claude.
Current Claude official hook contract uses tool_input.

findings.claim: A missing RN package receipt blocks; --auto-ground creates a fresh version latest receipt itself and permits the safe RN snippet without a prior compass invocation in this run.
limits: Receipt creation is observed; the gate receipt does not independently prove package declarations or external research were inspected.

findings.claim: A receipt with not-a-date timestamp is accepted by the direct pre-tool invocation.
limits: NaN age comparison is inferred from JavaScript expression plus matching observed exit0.

findings.claim: Stop gate reports clean for a newly untracked nested directory containing a banned RN symbol; staging the same file makes it reject with exit2.
limits: Git directory collapsing from status porcelain explains the missed input. No production Git index was changed.

findings.claim: Stop gate exits0 without diagnostic outside a Git repository.
limits: Exit0 alone must not be interpreted as evidence that verification ran.

findings.claim: Pre-tool gate bypasses non-code documents and JSON; stop gate excludes packages/core, tooling, .agents, and tests from its RN scan. These checks do not govern project narrative freshness or complete engineering work state.
limits: This is scoped code inspection, not a claim that no other independent checks cover these files.

findings.claim: An older workflow still prescribes tRPC and fixed palette values, conflicting with currently applicable AGENTS requirements for native oRPC and world recipes.
limits: The workflow latest commit is a February merge; file date alone is not the authority rule. Supplied current AGENTS explicitly defines applicable current direction.

findings.claim: The PR guard invokes check:anti-slop as required; the scheduled deep-quality workflow separately runs informational aislop and fallow with continue-on-error.
limits: No CI run, branch protection, or required-status settings were queried. A workflow definition is not deployed/run evidence.
No PJC or capability-conformance invocation found by text search across .github/workflows YAML. Indirect invocation through scripts was not exhaustively traced.

findings.claim: Pstack routing defines prose playbooks and model-interpreted triggers. Its decision-log helper appends TSV rows, but does not validate source authority, evidence truth, requirement links, or permitted workflow transitions.
limits: Shell helper writes timestamp and sanitized cells; semantics are still reviewed by agents.

findings.claim: Local codex-cli 0.159.2 reports hooks stable true. No project registration binding the RN gate was found in .codex TOML or backup config. Current-session automatic hook interception remains unverified.
commands: Scoped hook-key search in project .codex and user config
limits: Feature availability does not establish a hook is registered, trusted, invoked, or enforcing.
No live Codex session was started and no hook trust configuration was changed.
Project has config.toml.bak, not an active config.toml. Existing native agent registrations are web-specific roles.

findings.claim: Current receipts and gates address package freshness and RN source checks rather than persistent engineering-change lifecycle. A separate adapter would need explicit change identity, action/result records, invalidation, transition evaluation and durable resume contracts.
limits: This is a design inference from the inspected subsystem, not an exhaustive repository-wide absence claim.
Receipt naming hashes projectRoot and raw .git/HEAD content; the referenced code does not resolve branch refs to a commit or hash imported package declarations.

API transport and UI color sourcing

canaryEvidence.doesNotProve: Automatic interception in current Codex or Claude sessions, all parser paths, CI execution, or production behavior.

failureModes: Missing/mismatched payload can become exit0 without checking the proposed edit.
Self-minted grounding receipt can be mistaken for independent investigation evidence.
Invalid timestamp produces no stale receipt rejection in the observed path.
Git status may collapse untracked directories and the stop scan can miss nested files.
Errors and absent Git state may be converted to successful exit codes.
Prose procedures require agent compliance rather than mechanically evaluated transitions.
designConstraints: Preserve current source authorities and distinguish declared/configured/invoked/enforced.
Validate event envelopes explicitly and represent unsupported inputs as unverified rather than clean.
Separate evidence producer from transition evaluator; receipt timestamp is not research proof.
Fingerprint exact relevant source revisions and dependency declarations, not raw branch ref text.
Persist change and action identity, input fingerprints, evidence pointers, validity and unresolved decisions.
Resume only unaffected completed work; source changes invalidate dependent results.
Report missing or failed checks explicitly and preserve an incomplete state.
ownership: Only this JSON output is written in the repository. Scripts were copied into a fresh TEMP directory; git init and git add operated only in TEMP.
